# Code Anchors: Additive Surface Fold

- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the registry the folded capabilities were added to while the second name still declared them, and the single surviving dispatcher after the withdrawal.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/fold-toolkit.spec.ts` — the fold's own suite: every folded capability reachable by its new dispatch name, with the arguments, exit codes and failure signalling it had before.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/build-bundles.ts` — the entry-point table the withdrawal reduced to one, ending the overlap the fold opened.
- `package.json` — the manifest whose binary block carried both names during the overlap and one after it.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/component-invocations.ts` — resolves a body against the live surface, which is what forces the fold to precede the body rewrite.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/component-invocations.spec.ts` — proves an unrewritten body still passes while both names resolve, which is what makes the rewrite separately shippable.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/config-cli.ts`, `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/run.ts`, `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/args.ts` — the shared program-name text flipped to the surviving name at the fold rather than threaded through each invocation.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/allowlist.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/allowlist-docs.spec.ts` — the published permission grant the withdrawal reduced with the binary count, held byte-identical across three surfaces.
